g.text: Selects existing Spring beans; it does not instantiate them.
getStrategy() falls back to DEFAULT for blank/unknown codes.
Checkout quotes and order creation use supported methods only.
Fees are fixed strategy constants, not courier API calls.
Creates the aggregate in memory; orchestration persists it.
Group, order and payment amounts derive from server prices.
Object factory, not an Abstract Factory product family.
Runs in the publishing transaction; not an async queue
Spring supplies repository implementations at runtime.
All 20 interfaces in project.project.Repository extend JpaRepository;
AuthSessionRepository uses String IDs, all others use Long IDs.
Only representative repositories are shown here.
Class members are selected; ellipses omit parameters for readability.
Repeated client/interface names are views of the same Java types in each pattern.
